page.layout: One printed page, a title page. Top: the title block, printed upside down on the scan, with the author's name, the title, the subtitle lines and the printer's device (an oval woodcut with a motto, no text). Below the device: the imprint in three lines, also upside down.

main_text.l: De natura hominis incensis in peccato, & gratia
Dei ex peccato euocantis omnes communiter
TE in hominibus & singulis hominibus, quatenus

page.notes: The title block and imprint are printed upside down on the scan; the reading order above follows the text, not the orientation. The line "Cum ... antiqua libelli" is partly obscured by show-through and damage; the marked word is doubtful. "Alterio Catholicae" and the date line are read from a degraded print. The printer's device is an engraving with a motto (not transcribed). The date reads clɔ. Iɔ. XCIII. in the original, i.e. MDXCIII.
